t: This is 17 Hamilton Terrace in St John's Wood, a building in Westminster. It matters because the writer and playwright Enid Bagnold died here. She was born in 1889 and lived until 1981. Bagnold is best known for the 1935 story National Velvet. She became Lady Jones through marriage, and she was also a dramatist and memoirist. It's a quiet residential address, and it was the last home of one of the most popular storytellers of her time.
